description_en: Retrieves the details of an Employee Identity and Access Management (EIAM) account
description_zh: 调用GetUser接口，查询一个EIAM账户详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun eiam-developerapi get-user --authorization Bearer_AT8csE2seYxxxxxij --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --user-id user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetUser

parameters.help_en: The authentication information. The value is in the Bearer ${access_token} format. Example: Bearer ATxxxx
parameters.help_zh:
认证信息。
格式：Bearer ${access_token}。
示例：Bearer ATxxxx
parameters.name: authorization

accountExpireTime.description_en: The time when the account expires. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
accountExpireTime.description_zh: 账户过期时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
accountExpireTime.title_en: 账户过期时间, 毫秒时间
accountExpireTime.title_zh: 账户过期时间, 毫秒时间

createTime.description_en: The time when the account was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
createTime.description_zh: 账户创建时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
createTime.title_en: 创建时间, 毫秒时间
createTime.title_zh: 创建时间, 毫秒时间

customFields.description_en: The extended fields of the account

fieldName.description_en: The name of the extended field

fieldValue.description_en: The value of the extended field. Field values are returned as strings regardless of the data types of the fields. For example, true or false is returned for a Boolean field
fieldValue.description_zh:
字段数据值。
任何数据类型的字段值均以字符串的方式返回。比如布尔类型返回的值为"true"或"false"

displayName.description_en: The display name of the account

email.description_en: The email address of the user

emailVerified.description_en: Indicates whether the email address has been verified. A value of true indicates that the email address has been verified by the user or has been set to the verified status by the administrator. A value of false indicates that the email address has not been verified
emailVerified.description_zh: 邮箱是否已验证，true表示邮箱已经过用户的验证或被管理员设置为已验证，false表示未验证

groups.description_en: The groups to which the account belongs

items.description_en: The information about the group to which the account belongs

lockExpireTime.description_en: The time when the account lock expires. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
lockExpireTime.description_zh: 账户锁定过期时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
lockExpireTime.title_en: 锁定过期时间, 毫秒时间
lockExpireTime.title_zh: 锁定过期时间, 毫秒时间

organizationalUnits.description_en: The organizational units to which the account belongs

organizationalUnitId.description_en: The ID of the organizational unit

organizationalUnitName.description_en: The name of the organizational unit

primary.description_en: Indicates whether the organizational unit is the primary organizational unit

passwordSet.description_en: Indicates whether the password is set

phoneNumber.description_en: The mobile number of the user who owns the account

phoneNumberVerified.description_en: Indicates whether the mobile number has been verified. A value of true indicates that the mobile number has been verified by the user or has been set to the verified status by the administrator. A value of false indicates that the mobile number has not been verified
phoneNumberVerified.description_zh: 手机号是否已验证，true表示手机号已经过用户验证或被管理员设置为已验证，false表示未验证

phoneRegion.description_en: The country code of the mobile number. For example, the country code of China is 86 without 00 or +
phoneRegion.description_zh: 手机地区编号,示例：中国大陆手区号为86，不带 00 或 +
phoneRegion.title_en: 手机地区编号,示例：中国大陆手区号为86，不带 00 或 +
phoneRegion.title_zh: 手机地区编号,示例：中国大陆手区号为86，不带 00 或 +

primaryOrganizationalUnitId.description_en: The ID of the primary organizational unit of the account

registerTime.description_en: The time when the account was registered. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
registerTime.description_zh: 账户注册时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒

status.description_en: The status of the account. Valid values: enabled disabled
status.description_zh:
账户状态，取值可选范围：
enabled - 启用中。
disabled - 禁用中
status.title_en: 账户状态, enabled:启用,disabled:禁用
status.title_zh: 账户状态, enabled:启用,disabled:禁用

updateTime.description_en: The time when the account was last modified. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
updateTime.description_zh: 账户最近一次更新时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
updateTime.title_en: 最近一次更新时间, 毫秒时间
updateTime.title_zh: 最近一次更新时间, 毫秒时间

userExternalId.description_en:
The external ID of the account. The external ID can be used to map external data to the data of the account in EIAM of Identity as a Service (IDaaS). By default, the external ID is the account ID.

Note: For accounts with the same source type and source ID, each account has a unique external ID
userExternalId.description_zh:
账户外部ID，用于外部数据与IDaaS账户的数据关联映射，默认为IDaaS账户ID。

说明：外部ID在同一来源类型和来源ID下唯一

userSourceId.description_en:
The source ID of the account.

If the account was created in IDaaS, its source ID is the ID of the IDaaS instance. If the account was imported, its source ID is the enterprise ID in the source. For example, if the account was imported from DingTalk, its source ID is the corpId value of the enterprise in DingTalk
userSourceId.description_zh:
账户来源ID。

自建类型默认为实例ID，其他类型，分别对应不同来源的企业ID，比如钉钉来源对应钉钉企业的corpId

userSourceType.description_en:
The source type of the account. Valid values:

build_in: The account was created in IDaaS.

ding_talk: The account was imported from DingTalk.

ad: The account was imported from Microsoft Active Directory (AD).

ldap: The account was imported from a Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) service
userSourceType.description_zh:
账户来源类型，取值可选范围：
build_in：自建。
ding_talk：钉钉导入。
ad：AD导入。
ldap：LDAP导入
userSourceType.title_en: 来源类型，build_in[自建],ding_talk[钉钉导入],ad[AD导入],ldap[LDAP导入]
userSourceType.title_zh: 来源类型，build_in[自建],ding_talk[钉钉导入],ad[AD导入],ldap[LDAP导入]
